name: Restore visibility gating so a hidden collector page never reads as finished
request: Restore visibility gating so a hidden collector page never reads as finished
checks: source assertions: both scripts gate and listen; every hidden discovery exit reports atBottom:false; the scan abort precedes the profile build; hidden is reported distinctly from an error
result: Neither content script can now mistake a hidden page for a finished one. Both gate on document.visibilityState === 'visible', listen for visibilitychange, and remember wentHidden. Discovery returns hidden:true with atBottom:false so the worker cannot read it as the end of the list; profile extraction throws hiddenPageError() before the profile is assembled and reports hidden separately from a failure, so nothing partial is ever saved.
